evals.prompt: Audit this Electron/React AI coding IDE composer component. Users toggle between Plan mode (read-only) and Agent mode (edits workspace files) using Shift+Tab or a small bottom-left select dropdown, then press Enter in the same textarea to submit. Deleting a thread opens a blocking 'Are you sure?' alertdialog, and the prompt textarea uses only useState('') so text clears on panel switch.
assertions: Triggers skill jef-raskin and cites ./DESIGN.md schema rules without subjective clichés (no 'clean', 'intuitive', 'modern', 'user-centered').
Triggers veto-01 (silent_plan_to_agent_mode_trap), veto-02 (volatile_draft_loss_on_reload_or_error), and veto-03 (blocking_confirm_on_reversible_delete).
Applies hard_veto scoring rubric (-35 each, capped at <=49, floored at 0) and outputs Verdict: BLOCK.
Provides KLM-GOMS operator comparison showing elimination of H (0.40s) and P (1.10s) shuttling via spring-loaded quasimodal dispatch (e.g., Enter = read-only, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter = repo mutation).

Refactors code to include continuous localStorage/IndexedDB draft persistence (<=500ms), automatic checkpoint/Undo stack (Cmd/Ctrl+Z), keyboard Delete/Backspace support, and non-blocking role='status' Undo toast replacing the blocking alertdialog.

evals.prompt: Review our high-volume B2B insurance claims desktop web app where 120-ticket/day adjusters must click an 'Edit' toolbar button to unlock notes, type updates, click 'Save Changes', and dismiss an 'Unsaved changes: Discard?' modal if they click Back. Frequent status actions are buried in a 3-level cascading dropdown that reorders items by recent clicks.
assertions: Triggers skill jef-raskin within primary regime saas_b2b_intensive.
Identifies veto-02 (volatile draft risk), veto-04 (forced_edit_mode_and_manual_save_lock), and veto-05 (deep_nested_menu_for_frequent_command + adaptive menu reordering violating flt-04/sig-05).
Outputs Verdict: BLOCK (if volatile draft loss confirmed) or REVISE (<=81 if strictly conditional blocks), respecting base-100 rubric math.

Computes explicit KLM-GOMS time savings from removing Edit and Save mouse round-trips (4H + 2P + 2K + 2M = 6.90s UI overhead saved per ticket) and cites Hick's Law to flatten the 3-level adaptive menu into a static ordered or <=250ms incremental-search list.
Refactors into modeless direct inline editing with continuous debounced autosave, offline localStorage fallback, and Undo revision history.

evals.prompt: Refactor our desktop IDE symbol-navigation and command toolbar. Currently, developers lift their hand to click unlabeled 24px SVG icons 600px away in the top bar and have three conflicting shortcuts plus a sticky 'Refactor Tool' verb-first mode where subsequent clicks overwrite unrelated functions until Escape is pressed.
assertions: Triggers skill jef-raskin within primary regime ai_native_desktop_ide.

Flags sig-01/heur-06 (sticky verb-first tool mode requiring noun-verb conversion), sig-04/heur-04 (keyboard-pointer homing tax H+P+K+H = 2.10s), sig-05/heur-10 (non-monotonic duplicate shortcuts), and sig-06/heur-09 (unlabeled domain-specific SVG buttons).

Applies Fitts's Law (a=50ms, b=150ms -> ~755.1 ms for D=600px, S=24px) and KLM-GOMS to justify replacing distant icon clicks with home-row incremental search (<=250ms match response) and visible text labels on domain controls.
Eliminates the sticky verb-first mode in favor of noun-verb selection-first execution with zero explicit Cancel click.
